source_clause: C3.) AC has on/ off state. Auto can automatically turn on AC. AC will break Auto. Defrost can automatically turn on AC (Do not show this change). Recirc can automatically turn on AC.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.4（C3）定出 A/C 之 on/off 狀態與其與 Auto／Defrost／Recirc 之四項連動，四個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：本節無配置條件，起始 PC 為 test-setup；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，EMEA 排除補並逐條答，第十二軸不補。為什麼這樣切：`-137`（Auto 自動開 A/C）與 `-138`（A/C 中斷 Auto）為相反方向之兩條連動，可各自獨立失效。刻意略過：`-139` 之 ER 以「A/C 按鈕狀態不變」驗「do not show this change」—— 條文所述之隱藏對象為**畫面上之呈現**，非 A/C 之實際開關，故 ER 停在按鈕而不宣稱壓縮機狀態（§6 可觀察性）。**R-C36-1 之逐條答本節四條有三條為 `no`**：ICE3 只述五者之 on/off 而不述任何連動，鏡射表之分界欄已明載。

interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab

tcs.tc_title: A/C has an on and off state
tcs.test_item: AC shall have an on/off state
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "A/C" on the climate screen
2. Press "A/C" again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "A/C" button is highlighted
2. The "A/C" button is no longer highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item: Auto shall be able to automatically turn on AC
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn "A/C" off and AUTO off from the climate screen
2. Turn AUTO on and read the "A/C" button
tcs.expected_result:
1. Neither "A/C" nor "AUTO" is highlighted
2. The "A/C" button is highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Defrost and Recirc turn A/C on without showing it
tcs.test_item: Defrost and Recirc shall be able to automatically turn on AC, and the system shall not show this change
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn "A/C" off from the climate screen and note the "A/C" button
2. Turn "FRONT DEF" on and read the "A/C" button
3. Turn "RECIRC" on and read the "A/C" button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "A/C" button is not highlighted
2. The "A/C" button is not highlighted
3. The "A/C" button is not highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
